title: The Singer Conjecture on Vanishing of L2-Cohomology of Aspherical Manifolds
exact_target: Must the L2-cohomology of a closed aspherical manifold be concentrated in its middle dimension, and vanish entirely in odd dimensions?

sources.citation: Avramidi, Okun, and Schreve, Homology Growth, Hyperbolization, and Fibering, Geometric and Functional Analysis 34 (2024), Section 1.8.
